headline: Frank Lampard urges Coventry to stay positive amid four-game losing streak
description: Coventry boss Frank Lampard has urged his players to stay positive ahead of Saturday's Premier League trip to Nottingham Forest.

headline: World soccer's hottest men's teams right now: Can anyone stop Barcelona?
description: Is there any team hotter in world soccer right now than Barcelona? Bill Connelly crunches the numbers to tell us the most in-form European teams heading into the international break.

headline: Liverpool's Dominik Szoboszlai on his best position: 'I just want to be on the pitch'
description: Liverpool midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai has said he does not mind where he plays under Andoni Iraola amid criticism of his recent performances.

headline: Andy Burnham watches Everton with Canadian PM Mark Carney
description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham enjoyed Everton's Carabao Cup victory over Wolves on Wednesday with Canadian counterpart and fellow Toffees fan Mark Carney.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal still keen on Real Madrid winger Rodrygo
description: Arsenal remain in contact with the camp of Real Madrid winger Rodrygo as a potential long-term target Transfer talk has the latest.

headline: Man United will be 'careful' with Gabriel future, Carrick says
description: Michael Carrick confirmed he is involved in conversations about JJ Gabriel's future after the 15-year-old's request to leave Manchester United made major ripples and that the team is being "careful" with the situation.
